question: How much enjoyment laid, but at end not Shiva-hood — as with kings?
premises: so much enjoyment lays; at end Shiva-hood, but not
as from freedom even a king favors someone
inference: Measured enjoyment, no end-Shiva-hood — as kings favor freely whom they will.
plain_english: So much enjoyment lays; at end Shiva-hood, but not — as from freedom even a king favors someone.
